Hi Lisa / ACME team,

Target: have a wave-by-wave mutual action plan by EOW Sep 17 so ACME can approve the PO and deposit schedule.

I attached our current inventory ETA snapshot and a preliminary quote that maps expected OEM shipment windows to estimated provisioning dates on our side. I am looping in Vertex (procurement@vertex-oem.com) and their account lead Marco so they can confirm SKU-level timing.

Subject: Vertex quote & proposed shipment cadence for ACME (ref: ACME-DED-2491)

Hi all —

Attached is the formal Vertex quote. Key points:

1) SKU availability: constrained on TGI-64X GPUs; estimated first shipments the week of 2026-10-25.
2) Proposed fulfillment cadence: 3 waves over six weeks (initial pilot 10 racks, week 1; secondary wave 30 racks week 3; final 60 racks week 6). We can compress to weekly waves if ACME confirms accelerated deposit.
3) Commercials: 30% deposit at PO, 40% on second wave shipment, 30% on final acceptance.
4) Leadtime caveat: availability is queue-dependent; we recommend the PO go to 'release schedule' with specific release dates to lock queue positions.

We need a formal PO and a signed SOW to hold the schedule. Happy to discuss alternative staggered options (smaller weekly waves vs. larger batched waves).

Regards,
Marco Santos
Director, Global Procurement — Vertex OEM
marco@vertex-oem.com

Thanks Marco / Lisa — good context. Internal ask:

Proposal from Redwood side (recommended):
- Wave A (pilot): 10 racks for initial validation + onboarding (deliver week of Oct 25)
- Wave B (ramp): 30 racks (deliver target week of Nov 08)
- Wave C (scale): 60 racks (deliver target week of Nov 29)

Action items:
- Ben: confirm customer contract milestone dates and whether ACME will accept the 30/40/30 deposit schedule or need alternative terms.
- Dev: confirm rack/uplink pre-reqs and whether we need temporary cloud-bursting for weeks between waves.
- Jonas/Marissa: finalize a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) by Sep 17 that ties shipments to payment milestones.

Reasoning: a 3-wave plan reduces single-point delivery risk and lets us stand up Stratus pools incrementally. If Vertex can commit to weekly waves with a release schedule we can accelerate.

Quick technical notes from infra:

- Rack/Uplink: we need 40G uplinks per rack and redundant top-of-rack switches. See attached Rack_Uplink_Specs.xlsx for exact port counts and PDUs.
- Staging: recommend we keep a 2-week buffer of spare nodes (hot-swap) during the ramp to absorb any delayed shipments without impacting ACME's go-live windows.
- Cloud-burst: Stratus suggested a 48–72h flip time; that works for temporary bursts but network peering and test harnessing will add ~3 business days for full validation.

Implication: If Vertex can provide release schedule dates with week-level granularity we can plan blue/green standing up of customer pools. Otherwise we'll need to buy ~10% buffer inventory up-front.
